title: userRigidBodyTest.py: solve the standard, the Python and the symbolic body one after the other with the computation time shown
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-17: the three kinds of the body (ObjectRigidBody, ObjectUserBody with Python user functions, ObjectUserBody with symbolic user functions) are solved in a loop, each in its own system, with show.computationTime and verboseMode on, so that the cost of each mode is visible.
releaseNotes: userRigidBodyTest.py solves the body as ObjectRigidBody, as ObjectUserBody with Python user functions and with symbolic user functions one after the other, each with its computation time.
